## UploadTarget interface

Where a remote caller POSTs bytes before writing them to an app.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface UploadTarget
```

## Remarks

Issued by the service for one upload. Bytes beyond `maxBytes`<!-- -->, or sent after `expiresAt`<!-- -->, are rejected.
